$comment: Vendored, not owned here. The epistemic_type value set is defined ONCE, by the Internet-Draft draft-mih-agent-evidence-layer-00 (Evidence Layer, posted to the IETF datatracker as revision 00), section 4.1 'Epistemic Type', which states that "epistemic_type is closed and is this document's". Until IANA creates the 'Evidence Layer Epistemic Types' registry, the interim registry is agent-action-capsule spec/REGISTRY.md section 17. This file is a literal, lower-case transcription of that closed set (the same values as agent-action-capsule's schemas/vendor/epistemic-types.json), so capsule-engine's EPISTEMIC_TYPE_VALUES parity test reads a machine-readable copy, never a second hand-typed enum. A change to the owning set is a drift that must be re-vendored here, not silently re-derived.
